d:
Sofoklis Schortsanitis showed the world why they called him BABY SHAQ in one of the biggest upsets in international basketball history!
During the semifinals of the 2006 FIBA Basketball World Championship, Greece faced a star-studded Team USA featuring Carmelo Anthony, LeBron James and Dwyane Wade. The Americans took a 12-point lead, but Greece refused to back down!
Baby Shaq was UNSTOPPABLE in the paint, scoring 14 points in just 17 minutes and shooting an incredible 6-of-7 from the field! His dominant performance helped Greece turn the game around and stun Team USA 101-95.
